note: Rectangles are approximate starter values in die-pixel space (master 4700x5000). Refine by running z80_view_set + z80_render_region in the app and updating this file. Blocks are matched smallest-first, so nested sub-blocks win over parents.

blocks.name: PLA
blocks.description: Programmable logic array (decoder) — 99 rows that classify the current opcode into control signals.

blocks.name: ALU
blocks.description: Arithmetic/Logic Unit — four slices, nibble-at-a-time operations on UBUS and VBUS.

blocks.name: Register File
blocks.description: General-purpose and index registers: PC, SP, HL, BC, DE, WZ, IX, IY.

blocks.name: Instruction Register
blocks.description: Instruction register (IR) + CB/ED/DD/FD prefix latches and primary decode logic.

blocks.name: I/R Register
blocks.description: Interrupt-vector register (I) and DRAM refresh register (R).

blocks.name: Timing
blocks.description: M-cycle and T-state latches (m1..m5, t1..t6) plus ixy_d_phase modifier.
